svg.aria-label: Manan N Ghodasara — FullStack MERN Developer
svg.title: Manan N Ghodasara — FullStack MERN Developer
svg.desc: Build. Break. Learn. Repeat. FullStack MERN Developer based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Stack: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C++; React, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion; Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Socket.IO; MongoDB, PostgreSQL (Prisma), Pinecone; RAG Pipelines, Groq LLM, Gemini, HuggingFace; AWS S3, Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Docker.
